title: Clara Mullner
wikitext:
[[File:Alex's Mum.png|right|200px|thumb|Clara cradles baby [[Alex]].]] '''Clara''' is [[Alex]]'s deceased mother. During Alex's [[Alex#Eight Hearts|eight heart event]], he states that she died 12 years ago, sometime in the [[summer]]. When she died, Alex had to move in with his grandparents, [[George]] and [[Evelyn]], who were Clara's parents. During Alex's memory of her, Clara is seen holding Alex as a baby and singing to him. She has brown hair, with two blue hair bands, and is wearing a purple shirt. In the memory, Alex is wrapped in a blue blanket with the letter "A" sewn on it and has a green pacifier in his mouth. Her relationship with Alex's father is assumed to have been strained since Alex describes him as being either absent or drunk. Clara's surname is unknown; it may or may not be "Mullner". The name "Mullner" is used in only four places in the game: #In [[Penny]]'s Two Heart event, Penny speaks to [[George]], calling him "Mr. Mullner". #[[Secret Notes#Secret Note #5|Secret Note #5]] refers to George as "Mr. Mullner", and to Evelyn as Granny Mullner. #[[Secret Notes#Secret Note #12|Secret Note #12]] refers to George and Evelyn's home as "The Mullners'". #After the player marries [[Alex]], and talks to [[Pam]], she will say "So you married the Mullner boy, huh?" ==Letter== On the nightstand in George and Evelyn's bedroom, there is a letter from Clara. {{Squote|Momma-

If you're reading this, it means I've passed on. I'm so sorry you had to go through this. Know that I love you both.

Don't be too upset, I'm with Yoba now.

My final request: take care of Alex. He needs a family, something stable. He's a good kid.

Love, Clara}} ==History== {{History|1.3.27|Added [[Secret Notes]] with references to the name "Mullner".}} [[Category:Characters]] [[de:Clara Mullner]] [[es:Clara Mullner]] [[fr:Clara Mullner]] [[it:Clara Mullner]] [[ja:クララ]] [[ko:클라라 멀너]] [[hu:Clara Mullner]] [[pt:Clara Mullner]] [[ru:Клара]] [[tr:Clara Muller]] [[zh:克莱拉]]
